entities.label: SPRUJ26A
entities.description: Motor Control SDK Universal Project and Lab User's Guide, Rev. A (September 2021, revised April 2024); covers building a custom board, supporting new BLDC motor drivers, porting to new C2000 MCUs, and motor control parameters.
aliases: Universal Motor Control Project and Lab User's Guide

entities.label: Universal Motor Control Lab
entities.description: Motor Control SDK universal project and lab whose reference code is migrated to custom boards, new BLDC motor drivers, and new C2000 MCUs.

entities.label: universal_motorcontrol_syscfg
entities.description: SysConfig-enabled version of the universal motor control lab; replaces universal_motorcontrol_lab in porting instructions.

entities.label: MotorControl SDK
entities.description: Motor Control SDK whose software is migrated for use with a custom board; also a source of example peripheral functions.

entities.label: C2000Ware
entities.description: Provides device support files (device.c/h, target configs, generic cmd files) and driverlib sources used when porting the lab.

entities.label: C2000Ware driverlib
entities.description: C2000Ware driver library; e.g. can.c is linked to add CAN; driverlib APIs differ slightly between devices.

entities.label: Code Composer Studio
entities.description: CCS IDE used to add/link files, import the projectspec, and rebuild the ported project.

entities.label: SysConfig
entities.description: Configuration tool; the SysConfig-enabled lab needs device/package updated in sysConfigBuildOptions of the projectspec.

entities.label: C2000
entities.description: TI C2000 real-time microcontroller platform targeted by the universal lab.

entities.label: InstaSPIN-FOC
entities.description: Sensorless FOC solution; several user_mtr1.h parameters are used only by InstaSPIN-FOC FAST.

entities.label: InstaSPIN-BLDC
entities.description: BLDC control option of the lab with its own open-loop ramp and integration-threshold parameters.

entities.label: FAST
entities.description: FAST estimator; motor parameters can be identified through the FAST identification process.

entities.label: eSMO
entities.description: Enhanced sliding mode observer estimator with Kslide gain and PLL parameters.

entities.label: PLL
entities.description: eSMO phase-locked loop whose gain is bounded by USER_MOTOR1_PLL_KP_MAX/MIN.

entities.label: PI controller
entities.description: PI regulators for speed and current with gain scheduling by speed/current condition.

entities.label: Field weakening control (FWC)
entities.description: Field weakening control using a PI regulator and maximum vector angle (0 to -45 deg).

entities.label: FOC
entities.description: Field-oriented control; Kp of FOC current controllers is scaled by USER_M1_R_OVER_L_KP_SF.

entities.label: PMSM
entities.description: Permanent magnet synchronous motor; MOTOR_TYPE_PM covers BLDC, PMSM, SMPM, IPM motors.

entities.label: BLDC
entities.description: Brushless DC motor driven by C2000 MCUs with BLDC motor drivers.

entities.label: ACIM
entities.description: Asynchronous AC induction motor; selected with MOTOR_TYPE_INDUCTION.

entities.label: F280025C
entities.description: C2000 MCU on the LAUNCHXL-F280025C used as the reference/source device in the porting example.

entities.label: F28002x
entities.description: Device family of the source lab folder 'f28002x'; supports Fast Integer Division (FINTDIV) and has no PGA.

entities.label: F28004x
entities.description: Example new target C2000 MCU for porting; does not support FINTDIV but has a Programmable Gain Amplifier (PGA).

entities.label: F280049C
entities.description: F28004x device whose target configuration name (TMS320F280049C) is used for all F28004x devices; has separate CMPSS modules for each phase current input.

entities.label: F28003x
entities.description: Device family whose LaunchPad and controlCARD support was added in Rev. A.

entities.label: F280013x
entities.description: Device family whose LaunchPad and controlCARD support was added in Rev. A.

entities.label: LAUNCHXL-F280025C
entities.description: LaunchPad used with BOOSTXL-DRV8323RS as the example combination for PWM, ADC and CMPSS connections; only CMPSS1 and CMPSS3 are available for current sensing pins.

entities.label: LAUNCHXL-F280049C
entities.description: F280049C LaunchPad cited as having separate CMPSS modules for each phase current input.

entities.label: BOOSTXL-DRV8323RS
entities.description: BoosterPack with DRV8323RS gate driver used in the custom-board configuration examples.

entities.label: DRV8329AEVM
entities.description: TI hardware whose support was added in Rev. A.

entities.label: DRV8323RS
entities.description: SPI BLDC motor gate driver used as the example for supporting a new BLDC motor driver; driver files drv8323s.h/.c.

entities.label: DRV8323RH
entities.description: Hardware-interface DRV8323 variant; single-phase current sensing CMPSS defines apply to DRV8323RH and RS only.

entities.label: DRV8353
entities.description: BLDC motor driver supported by HAL_setupSPI/HAL_setupGate/HAL_enableDRV code paths.

entities.label: DRV8316
entities.description: BLDC motor driver supported by HAL_setupSPI/HAL_setupGate/HAL_enableDRV code paths.

entities.label: Custom motor driver board
entities.description: User-designed application board to drive a motor; requires correct MCU/gate-driver power and JTAG connectivity before migrating the reference code.

entities.label: JTAG emulator
entities.description: Debug emulator that must connect successfully to a custom board.

entities.label: Current sense amplifier
entities.description: Amplifier whose output is compared against the CMPSS DAC threshold for overcurrent trip.

entities.label: ePWM
entities.description: Generates the inverter PWM signals (EPWM1/2/3 or 6 for U/V/W), triggers ADC SOC, and provides trip-zone shutdown on faults.

entities.label: ADC
entities.description: Samples phase currents, phase voltages, DC bus voltage and potentiometer; triggered by EPWM1 SOCA.

entities.label: CMPSS
entities.description: Comparator subsystem used for phase-current overcurrent monitoring; a DAC sets the threshold and the CMPSS output trips.

entities.label: DAC
entities.description: 12-bit DAC in each CMPSS that sets the high/low overcurrent thresholds, referenced to VDDA.

entities.label: X-BAR
entities.description: ePWM X-BAR and Input X-BAR route CMPSS trip outputs and the nFAULT GPIO to the ePWM trip zone.

entities.label: GPIO
entities.description: Pins configured in HAL_setupGPIOs() for PWM outputs, SPI, CAN, buttons, enable and nFAULT.

entities.label: SPI
entities.description: Serial interface from the MCU to the BLDC motor driver (SPIA, 16-bit words, POL0PHA0, master).

entities.label: CAN
entities.description: CAN bus (CANA) that can be added for start/stop commands and feedback of running states.

entities.label: PGA
entities.description: Programmable Gain Amplifier present on F28004x but not F28002x; needs added functions when porting.

entities.label: eQEP
entities.description: Quadrature encoder module whose position counter max is USER_MOTOR1_ENC_POS_MAX.

entities.label: TMU
entities.description: Trigonometric math unit; the lab can be ported to FPU and TMU enabled C2000 MCUs.

entities.label: FPU
entities.description: Floating-point unit required on target C2000 MCUs for porting.

entities.label: PIE
entities.description: Peripheral interrupt expansion; ADC and CAN ISRs registered and acknowledged via PIE groups.

entities.label: Fast Integer Division (FINTDIV)
entities.description: F28002x capability enabled via --idiv_support=idiv0; must be removed from projectspec for F28004x.

entities.label: Overcurrent protection
entities.description: Phase overcurrent detected by CMPSS against DAC thresholds, tripping ePWM outputs low via trip zone.

entities.label: Fault protection
entities.description: On driver nFAULT or CMPSS overcurrent, ePWM X-BAR and trip zones force PWM outputs low.

entities.label: ePWM trip zone
entities.description: ePWM trip-zone submodule; DCAEVT1/DCBEVT1 one-shot trips force EPWMxA/B low.

entities.label: Dead band
entities.description: ePWM dead-band rising/falling edge delays set by MTR1_PWM_DBRED_CNT/DBFED_CNT; active-high complementary.

entities.label: Three-shunt current sensing
entities.description: Three phase-current sensing with per-phase CMPSS mux defines.

entities.label: Single-shunt current sensing
entities.description: DC-link single shunt sensing with USER_M1_IDC_OFFSET_AD and DCLINKSS timing parameters.

entities.label: ADC current/voltage scaling
entities.description: Max phase current/voltage at ADC input, based on sensing circuitry; defines scale factors assuming 12-bit ADC.

entities.label: Open-loop V/F profile
entities.description: Linear voltage/frequency region defined by FREQ_LOW/HIGH and VOLT_MIN/MAX.

entities.label: DC bus over/under-voltage protection
entities.description: Fault when DC bus voltage leaves user-defined range, with hysteresis norm thresholds.

entities.label: Motor fault detection
entities.description: Lost phase, phase unbalance, over-load power, stall, failed startup and over-speed faults with time-set filters.

entities.label: PI gain scheduling
entities.description: Kp*/Ki* adjusted by startup/low/high gain coefficients and linear interpolation across condition range.

entities.label: ADC offset calibration
entities.description: Automatic offset calibration via flagEnableOffsetCalc; runMotor1OffsetsCalculation() runs it at startup.

entities.label: Motor parameter identification
entities.description: FAST/InstaSPIN Motor ID estimating Rs, Ls and flux.

entities.label: Rs online recalibration
entities.description: Recalibrates stator resistance in closed loop intermittently, injecting non-torque d-axis current.

entities.label: Force angle startup
entities.description: Startup option using a forced angle frequency (typ. +-1 Hz) near zero speed.

entities.label: Flying start
entities.description: Startup into a spinning motor with threshold USER_MOTOR1_SPEED_FS_Hz.

entities.label: Braking
entities.description: Braking state with defined current and delay.

entities.label: Push button / command switch control
entities.description: GPIO button (e.g. GPIO23) to start/stop the motor, enabled by CMD_SWITCH_EN.

entities.label: Potentiometer speed control
entities.description: Potentiometer on ADCA12 starts/stops motor and sets speed reference, enabled by CMD_POT_EN.

entities.label: CAN command control
entities.description: CAN bus for start/stop commands and feedback, enabled by CMD_CAN_EN.

entities.label: Speed pulse control
entities.description: Motor speed calculated from a pulse on an input GPIO; speed above max disables motor.

entities.label: BUILDLEVEL_LEVEL1
entities.description: Incremental build level 1; custom board code is run starting at level 1 through level 4.

entities.label: BUILDLEVEL_LEVEL2
entities.description: Incremental build level 2; custom board code is run starting at level 1 through level 4.

entities.label: BUILDLEVEL_LEVEL3
entities.description: Incremental build level 3; custom board code is run starting at level 1 through level 4.

entities.label: BUILDLEVEL_LEVEL4
entities.description: Incremental build level 4; custom board code is run starting at level 1 through level 4.

entities.label: Custom board hardware setup
entities.description: Custom board migration step 1: Verify MCU and gate driver power supplies are correct and the JTAG emulator connects.

entities.label: Set hardware board parameters
entities.description: Custom board migration step 2: Set ADC full-scale current/voltage, filter pole, and sensor counts in user_mtr1.h per the sensing circuit.

entities.label: Modify motor control parameters
entities.description: Custom board migration step 3: Set motor type, pole pairs, Rs, Ls, flux and max current in user_mtr1.h from datasheet or FAST ID.

entities.label: Change pin assignment
entities.description: Custom board migration step 4: Change GPIO mux, direction and pad configuration in HAL_setupGPIOs() to match the board.

entities.label: Configure PWM module
entities.description: Custom board migration step 5: Define PWM base addresses in hal.h, GPIO PWM outputs, PWM period, dead band, and ADC SOC trigger.

entities.label: Configure ADC module
entities.description: Custom board migration step 6: Define ADC base, result, channel, SOC and PPB numbers and interrupt sources in hal.h; set up SOCs in HAL_setupADCs().

entities.label: Configure CMPSS module
entities.description: Custom board migration step 7: Define CMPSS bases and ADC-to-CMPSS mux selects in hal.h; HAL_setupCMPSSs() configures comparators, filters and DACs.

entities.label: Configure fault protection
entities.description: Custom board migration step 8: Define nFAULT GPIO and X-BAR trip muxes in hal.h; HAL_setupMtrFaults() configures X-BAR and ePWM trip zones.

entities.label: Design driver file for new BLDC driver
entities.description: New BLDC motor driver support step 1: Adapt drv8323s.h/.c registers and APIs into drv8xxx.h/.c; create libraries/drvic folders.

entities.label: Add BLDC driver source files to project
entities.description: New BLDC motor driver support step 2: Link driver files via projectspec <file action=link> or CCS Add Files.

entities.label: Add driver header include
entities.description: New BLDC motor driver support step 3: Include drv8323s.h in hal_obj.h and add include path.

entities.label: Add drvic and SPI handles to HAL_Obj
entities.description: New BLDC motor driver support step 4: Map DRVIC_* defines to DRV8323_* and add spiHandle, drvicHandle, drvic, gateEnableGPIO.

entities.label: Configure SPI for BLDC driver
entities.description: New BLDC motor driver support step 5: Configure SPI GPIOs and SPI baud rate/data frame in HAL_setupSPI().

entities.label: Configure ENABLE and nFAULT GPIOs
entities.description: New BLDC motor driver support step 6: Define MTR1_GATE_EN_GPIO and MTR1_PM_nFAULT_GPIO; see HAL_setupGPIOs(), HAL_setupGate().

entities.label: Call HAL_setupSPI and HAL_setupGate
entities.description: New BLDC motor driver support step 7: Call HAL_setupSPI() and HAL_setupGate() in HAL_MTR_setParams().

entities.label: Call driver functions in motor1_drive.c
entities.description: New BLDC motor driver support step 8: Call HAL_enableDRV() and HAL_setupDRVSPI() in motor1_drive.c.

entities.label: Change BLDC driver default settings
entities.description: New BLDC motor driver support step 9: Set drvicVars_M1 control register fields and write with HAL_writeDRVData().

entities.label: Supporting new BLDC motor driver board
entities.description: Procedure (Section 4.2) to implement new or unsupported BLDC motor drivers in the universal lab, using DRV8323RS with SPI as example.

entities.label: Copy existing device-specific lab folder
entities.description: Porting to new C2000 MCU step: Copy an existing lab folder (e.g. f28002x) and rename it f28004x.

entities.label: Rename linker cmd files
entities.description: Porting to new C2000 MCU step: Rename f28002x_flash_lib_is.cmd in the cmd folder for the new device.

entities.label: Replace device.c/device.h
entities.description: Porting to new C2000 MCU step: Copy device.h/device.c from C2000Ware device_support for the new MCU into the lab drivers folders.

entities.label: Edit projectspec file
entities.description: Porting to new C2000 MCU step: Update SysConfig device/package, remove unsupported options (idiv_support), replace 28002x with 28004x, update device and ccxml names.

entities.label: Import ported project into CCS
entities.description: Porting to new C2000 MCU step: Import universal_motorcontrol_lab_f28004x; missing headers_nonbios cmd only affects watch window debugging.

entities.label: Update cmd memory map
entities.description: Porting to new C2000 MCU step: Change memory map in cmd files, optionally adapting generic C2000Ware cmd files.

entities.label: Modify HAL GPIO/PWM/ADC/CMPSS defines
entities.description: Porting to new C2000 MCU step: Modify GPIO, PWM, ADC and CMPSS modules and defines in hal.h as in Section 4.1.2.

entities.label: Rebuild and fix errors
entities.description: Porting to new C2000 MCU step: Rebuild; fix errors/warnings including driverlib API differences between devices.

entities.label: Add functions for new peripherals
entities.description: Porting to new C2000 MCU step: Add functions for peripherals present only on the new MCU (e.g. PGA on F28004x).

entities.label: Run incremental build levels
entities.description: Porting to new C2000 MCU step: Run the project incrementally using the build levels to verify functionality.

entities.label: Update lab source files
entities.description: Porting to new C2000 MCU step: Copy updated cmd, hal.c and hal.h back to the lab folder so changes are done once.

entities.label: Porting reference code to new C2000 MCU
entities.description: Procedure (Section 4.3) to port the universal lab to other FPU- and TMU-enabled C2000 MCUs, using F28004x as the example target.

entities.label: user_mtr1.h
entities.description: File storing all user hardware and motor control parameters for motor 1.

entities.label: user_common.h
entities.description: File containing USER_SYSTEM_FREQ_Hz.

entities.label: hal.h
entities.description: HAL header defining PWM/ADC/CMPSS bases, channels, SOCs, X-BAR muxes, fault and GPIO numbers.

entities.label: hal.c
entities.description: HAL source implementing HAL_init, HAL_setupGPIOs, HAL_setupPWMs, HAL_setupADCs, HAL_setupCMPSSs, HAL_setupMtrFaults, HAL_setupSPI.

entities.label: hal_obj.h
entities.description: Defines HAL_Obj structure; extended with canHandle, spiHandle and drvic handles.

entities.label: sys_main.c
entities.description: Main file calling HAL_init, HAL_MTR_setParams, initMotor1CtrlParameters, offsets calculation and interrupt setup.

entities.label: motor1_drive.c
entities.description: Motor 1 drive file defining initMotor1CtrlParameters and runMotor1OffsetsCalculation and calling HAL_enableDRV/HAL_setupDRVSPI.

entities.label: motor_common.c
entities.description: Contains updateCmdSwitch() and updateExtCmdPotFreq().

entities.label: communication.c
entities.description: Defines HAL_setupCANA, canaISR, initCANCOM, updateCANCmdFreq; prototypes in communication.h.

entities.label: Motor Control Parameters Calculation.xlsx
entities.description: Excel spreadsheet in solutions/universal_motorcontrol_lab/doc for calculating user_mtr1.h parameters.

entities.label: drv8323s.h / drv8323s.c
entities.description: Existing DRV8323 SPI driver files under libraries/drvic/drv8323, used as reference for new drivers.

entities.label: device.c / device.h
entities.description: C2000Ware device driver files with pin definitions and DEVICE_SYSCLK_FREQ; replaced for the new device.

entities.label: universal_motorcontrol_lab.projectspec
entities.description: CCS projectspec that generates the project and references device-specific C2000Ware files.

entities.label: f28002x_flash_lib_is.cmd
entities.description: Linker command file mapping MCU memory; renamed and adapted for the new device.

entities.label: f28004x_headers_nonbios.cmd
entities.description: Header cmd file used only by the debug watch window; may be reported missing on import.

entities.label: 28004x_generic_flash_lnk.cmd
entities.description: Generic C2000Ware cmd file that may be easier to adapt than the old device's cmd.

entities.label: HAL_init()
entities.description: Initializes the HAL handle; called in sys_main.c, defined in hal.c; also initializes CAN handle when added.

entities.label: HAL_MTR_setParams()
entities.description: Sets up HAL with user parameters; calls HAL_setupSPI() and HAL_setupGate() for SPI drivers.

entities.label: initMotor1CtrlParameters()
entities.description: Initializes motor control parameters; defined in motor1_drive.c.

entities.label: HAL_enableDRV()
entities.description: Turns on the DRV8323/DRV8353/DRV8316 if present; called in motor1_drive.c.

entities.label: HAL_setupDRVSPI()
entities.description: Initializes the DRV8323/DRV8353/DRV8316 SPI interface.

entities.label: HAL_setupFaults()
entities.description: Sets up faults depending on the board used; with HAL_disablePWM().

entities.label: runMotor1OffsetsCalculation()
entities.description: Runs ADC offset calibration; defined in motor1_drive.c.

entities.label: HAL_enableCtrlInts()
entities.description: Configures MCU interrupts with HAL_initIntVectorTable, HAL_enableGlobalInts, HAL_enableDebugInt before the forever loop.

entities.label: HAL_setupGPIOs()
entities.description: hal.c function configuring GPIO pin function, direction and pad config per the motor driver board.

entities.label: HAL_setupPWMs()
entities.description: hal.c function configuring ePWM counter mode (up-down), action qualifiers, dead band, ISR and ADC SOC trigger.

entities.label: HAL_setupADCs()
entities.description: hal.c function setting up ADC SOCs, e.g. ADC_setupSOC for the potentiometer.

entities.label: HAL_setupCMPSSs()
entities.description: hal.c function enabling CMPSS, DAC-sourced comparator inputs, digital filters (32,32,30), hysteresis and DAC high/low thresholds.

entities.label: HAL_setupMtrFaults()
entities.description: hal.c function configuring ePWM X-BAR TRIP7, Input X-BAR for nFAULT, and trip-zone DC events forcing PWM low.

entities.label: HAL_setupSPI()
entities.description: hal.c function configuring SPI (POL0PHA0, master, 400000 baud, 16-bit, FIFO) for the BLDC driver.

entities.label: HAL_setupGate()
entities.description: hal.c function setting up the drv8323s/drv8353s/drv8316s interface.

entities.label: HAL_setupCANA()
entities.description: communication.c function initializing CANA, bit rate and TX/RX message objects.

entities.label: HAL_enableCANInts()
entities.description: Enables CAN interrupts, PIE INT_CANA0 and CPU INT9.

entities.label: HAL_readMtr1ADCData()
entities.description: Reads ADC results (e.g. potAdc) into HAL_ADCData_t; added channels need code here.

entities.label: canaISR()
entities.description: CAN interrupt service routine handling TX/RX message objects; placed in .TI.ramfunc and acknowledged in PIE group 9.

entities.label: updateCANCmdFreq()
entities.description: Processes CAN received/transmitted data and links it to motor control variables; called in endless loop.

entities.label: updateCmdSwitch()
entities.description: motor_common.c function reading the switch GPIO with a digital filter and linking state to start/stop.

entities.label: updateExtCmdPotFreq()
entities.description: motor_common.c function converting the potentiometer ADC value to a speed value.

entities.label: USER_M1_ADC_FULL_SCALE_VOLTAGE_V
entities.description: Maximum voltage at the ADC input; scales ADC voltage readings.

entities.label: USER_M1_VOLTAGE_FILTER_POLE_Hz
entities.description: Analog voltage feedback filter pole location; must match hardware filter.

entities.label: USER_M1_ADC_FULL_SCALE_CURRENT_A
entities.description: Maximum current at the ADC input; scales ADC current readings.

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_TYPE
entities.description: Motor type: MOTOR_TYPE_PM (BLDC, PMSM, SMPM, IPM) or MOTOR_TYPE_INDUCTION.

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_NUM_POLE_PAIRS
entities.description: Number of motor pole pairs.

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_Rs_Ohm
entities.description: Stator resistance in Ohms.

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_Ls_d_H
entities.description: d-axis stator inductance in H.

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_Ls_q_H
entities.description: q-axis stator inductance in H.

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_RATED_FLUX_VpHz
entities.description: Rated motor flux in V/Hz.

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_MAX_CURRENT_A
entities.description: Maximum motor current; contributes to overcurrent handling.

entities.label: MTR1_PWM_U_BASE
entities.description: hal.h define of phase U PWM base address; also MTR1_PWM_V_BASE (EPWM2_BASE) and MTR1_PWM_W_BASE (EPWM6_BASE).

entities.label: USER_M1_PWM_TBPRD_NUM
entities.description: PWM period value setting the PWM frequency in HAL_setupPWMs().

entities.label: MTR1_PWM_DBRED_CNT
entities.description: Dead-band rising edge delay count defined in hal.h; with MTR1_PWM_DBFED_CNT for falling edge.

entities.label: MTR1_ADC_TRIGGER_SOC
entities.description: ADC start-of-conversion trigger source; must match the ePWM SOC enabled on pwmHandle[0].

entities.label: MTR1_IU_ADC_BASE
entities.description: ADC module for phase U current (with _ADCRES_BASE, _ADC_CH_NUM, _ADC_SOC_NUM, _ADC_PPB_NUM defines per signal IU/IV/IW/VU/VV/VW/VDC/POT).

entities.label: MTR1_IU_ADC_SOC_NUM
entities.description: SOC number for phase U current; multiple ADCs may share an SOC number across modules A and C to sample close together.

entities.label: MTR1_VDC_ADC_BASE
entities.description: ADC module for DC bus voltage (VSENVM on ADCINC6).

entities.label: MTR1_POT_ADC_BASE
entities.description: ADC module for potentiometer (ADCA12, SOC6).

entities.label: MTR1_ADC_INT_BASE
entities.description: ADC interrupt source for the control ISR (ADCA INT1 from SOC4), with MTR1_PIE_INT_NUM=INT_ADCA1.

entities.label: MTR1_CMPSS_U_BASE
entities.description: CMPSS base for phase U current; V uses CMPSS3_BASE, W shares CMPSS1_BASE.

entities.label: MTR1_IU_CMPHP_SEL
entities.description: ASYSCTL CMPHPMUX/CMPLPMUX select and _MUX defines that route phase current ADC inputs to CMPSS high/low comparators (IU, IV, IW, IDC).

entities.label: MTR1_CMPSS_DACH_VALUE
entities.description: CMPSS DAC high threshold (max +ve current); MTR1_CMPSS_DACL_VALUE sets max -ve current.

entities.label: MTR1_PM_nFAULT_GPIO
entities.description: GPIO for the power module nFAULT input, routed via Input X-BAR to the trip zone.

entities.label: MTR1_IU_XBAR_EPWM_MUX
entities.description: ePWM X-BAR mux for phase U (CMPSS1 CTRIPH); IV uses CMPSS3 CTRIPH_OR_L, IW uses CMPSS1 CTRIPL.

entities.label: MTR1_XBAR_TRIP
entities.description: ePWM X-BAR trip used for overcurrent (TRIP7) with MTR1_DCTRIPIN = EPWM_DC_COMBINATIONAL_TRIPIN7.

entities.label: CMD_SWITCH_EN
entities.description: Pre-define symbol enabling push button start/stop.

entities.label: CMD_POT_EN
entities.description: Pre-define symbol enabling potentiometer speed control.

entities.label: CMD_CAN_EN
entities.description: Pre-define symbol enabling CAN command functionality.

entities.label: MTR1_CMD_SWITCH_GPIO
entities.description: hal.h define of the command switch GPIO (pull-up, 3-sample qualification).

entities.label: motorVars_M1.flagEnableRunAndIdentify
entities.description: Motor start/stop variable assigned from switch, potentiometer or CAN commands.

entities.label: motorVars_M1.speedRef_Hz
entities.description: Speed reference set from potentiometer or CAN.

entities.label: Adding additional functionality
entities.description: Section 4.1.3: interface functions to start/stop the motor and set speed via push button, potentiometer, SCI or CAN.

entities.label: MTR1_GATE_EN_GPIO
entities.description: GPIO for enabling the power module (gate driver ENABLE).

entities.label: drvicVars_M1
entities.description: BLDC driver register variables; defaults set e.g. VDS_LVL 1.7V, OCP automatic retry, DEAD_TIME 100ns, CSA_GAIN 10V/V.

entities.label: USER_M1_NOMINAL_DC_BUS_VOLTAGE_V
entities.description: Nominal DC bus voltage; must exceed rated motor voltage and be below max sensing DC bus voltage.

entities.label: USER_M1_SIGN_CURRENT_SF

entities.label: USER_M1_NUM_CURRENT_SENSORS
entities.description: Number of current sensors (2 or 3, else compile error).

entities.label: USER_M1_NUM_VOLTAGE_SENSORS
entities.description: Number of phase voltage sensors (must be 3).

entities.label: USER_M1_Ix_OFFSET_AD
entities.description: ADC current offset per phase (A/B/C), close to 2048; updated by offset calibration.

entities.label: USER_M1_Vx_OFFSET_SF
entities.description: ADC voltage offset per phase, close to 0.5; used only for InstaSPIN-FOC FAST and InstaSPIN-BLDC.

entities.label: USER_M1_IDC_OFFSET_AD
entities.description: ADC current offset for single-shunt hardware.

entities.label: flagEnableOffsetCalc
entities.description: Flag enabling automatic ADC offset calibration.

entities.label: USER_M1_PWM_FREQ_kHz
entities.description: ePWM frequency in kHz; changing it alters the control interrupt frequency.

entities.label: USER_M1_NUM_PWM_TICKS_PER_ISR_TICK
entities.description: PWM periods per interrupt (1 to 3); divides control interrupt frequency.

entities.label: USER_M1_NUM_ISR_TICKS_PER_SPEED_TICK
entities.description: Interrupt ticks per speed controller tick.

entities.label: USER_M1_CURRENT_SF
entities.description: Derived scale of ADC bits to Amps assuming 12-bit ADC.

entities.label: USER_M1_VOLTAGE_SF
entities.description: Derived ADC voltage scale; used only by FAST and eSMO estimators.

entities.label: USER_M1_DCLINKSS_MIN_DURATION
entities.description: Minimum duration in clock cycles for single-shunt ADC readings.

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_INERTIA_Kgm2
entities.description: Moment of inertia; contributes to speed controller gain calculation.

entities.label: USER_M1_MAX_VS_MAG_PU
entities.description: Maximum voltage vector magnitude Vs in per-unit.

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_RES_EST_CURRENT_A
entities.description: Max current for stator resistance estimation (10%-40% of rated).

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_IND_EST_CURRENT_A
entities.description: Max current for stator inductance estimation (10%-20% of rated).

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_FLUX_EXC_FREQ_Hz
entities.description: Flux excitation frequency for inductance and flux estimation.

entities.label: USER_M1_FORCE_ANGLE_FREQ_Hz
entities.description: Force angle startup frequency, typically +-1 Hz.

entities.label: USER_M1_EST_BEMF_HF_SF
entities.description: Back-EMF estimation scale factor (default 1 for FAST; 0.5-1.25 otherwise).

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_Ls_d_COMP_COEF
entities.description: Ls d-axis compensation coefficient: Ls1 = Ls*(1 - coef).

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_RSONLINE_WAIT_TIME
entities.description: Wait time between Rs online calibration cycles in 5ms periods.

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_FREQ_LOW_Hz
entities.description: Low frequency boundary of open-loop V/F profile (~10% rated frequency).

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_VOLT_MAX_V
entities.description: Voltage generating USER_MOTOR1_FREQ_HIGH_Hz; set to rated voltage.

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_NUM_ENC_SLOTS
entities.description: Number of quadrature encoder slots; derives USER_MOTOR1_ENC_POS_MAX for eQEP.

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_KSLIDE_MAX
entities.description: Maximum eSMO Kslide gain (0.1-10).

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_PLL_KP_MAX
entities.description: Maximum eSMO PLL gain (0.1-10).

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_BEMF_THRESHOLD
entities.description: Estimated current error threshold for eSMO sliding mode controller (0.3-0.5, default 0.5).

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_RAMP_END_Hz
entities.description: Speed at which BEMF zero-cross commutation begins to be considered (10%-20% rated).

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_ISBLDC_INT_MAX
entities.description: Maximum integration voltage threshold for commutation point detection (0.01-0.15).

entities.label: USER_M1_FWC_KP
entities.description: Kp gain of FWC PI regulator (0.01-0.1); with USER_M1_FWC_KI.

entities.label: USER_M1_FWC_MAX_ANGLE
entities.description: Maximum FWC vector angle, 0 to -45 degrees.

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_RATED_VOLTAGE_V
entities.description: Rated motor voltage; could be NOMINAL_DC_BUS_VOLTAGE/sqrt(2).

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_FREQ_MAX_Hz
entities.description: Maximum rotational speed in Hz (100%-150% of rated).

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_SPEED_FS_Hz
entities.description: Flying-start speed threshold (0.1%-5% of rated).

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_BRAKE_CURRENT_A
entities.description: Motor current during braking (10%-50% of rated).

entities.label: USER_M1_IS_OFFSET_AD_DELTA
entities.description: Error threshold (0-200) for phase current ADC offsets; beyond triggers fault.

entities.label: USER_M1_OVER_VOLTAGE_FAULT_V
entities.description: DC bus over-voltage fault threshold; less than ADC full-scale voltage.

entities.label: USER_M1_UNDER_VOLTAGE_FAULT_V
entities.description: DC bus under-voltage fault threshold.

entities.label: USER_M1_LOST_PHASE_CURRENT_A
entities.description: Lost phase fault current threshold (0.1%-10% of rated).

entities.label: USER_M1_UNBALANCE_RATIO
entities.description: Phase unbalance ratio threshold (default 20%).

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_OVER_CURRENT_A
entities.description: Over-current threshold used to calculate CMPSS DAC values which trigger PWM trip-zone fault handling (50%-300% rated).

entities.label: USER_M1_OVER_LOAD_POWER_W
entities.description: Over-power fault threshold (50%-200% rated power).

entities.label: USER_M1_STALL_CURRENT_A
entities.description: Stall/failed-startup RMS current threshold below USER_M1_FAIL_SPEED_MIN_HZ.

entities.label: USER_M1_FAIL_SPEED_MAX_HZ
entities.description: Over-speed fault threshold (200%-500% rated).

entities.label: USER_M1_OVER_CURRENT_TIMES_SET
entities.description: Duration (5ms periods) to set over-current fault (0.01-0.5s).

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_GAIN_SPEED_LOW_Hz
entities.description: Low speed threshold for speed PI Kp*/Ki* adjustment (10%-30% rated).

entities.label: USER_MOTOR1_GAIN_IQ_LOW_A
entities.description: Low current threshold for q-axis current PI gain adjustment (10%-50% rated).

entities.label: USER_M1_POT_ADC_MIN
entities.description: Minimum potentiometer ADC value; below it speed is 0.

entities.label: USER_M1_POT_SPEED_SF
entities.description: Derived ADC-to-speed relationship for potentiometer control.

entities.label: USER_M1_SPEED_CAP_MAX_Hz
entities.description: Max speed in pulse control; above it the motor is disabled.

entities.label: USER_M1_SWITCH_WAIT_TIME_SET
entities.description: Minimum wait between switch state updates in 1ms periods (default 50ms).
